title: Trump’s $20,000 US visa bond rule may expand beyond 50 countries; travel industry warns it could hurt tourism, economy
content:
• The US Department of State has made permanent a visa bond programme requiring certain tourist and business visa applicants from 50 designated countries to post refundable bonds of up to $20,000.
• The US visa bond programme, made permanent this month, was initially introduced as a pilot in August 2025.
• During the pilot period, visa issuances to applicants from the covered countries fell 83%, and visa overstays reportedly dropped from 45,488 in fiscal 2024 to fewer than 50.

title: Assam-Arunachal border dispute explained: History, 2023 pact and why tensions persist
content:
• A landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Assam and Arunachal Pradesh was signed by CMs Himanta Biswa Sarma and Pema Khandu in New Delhi on April 20, 2023, in the presence of Union Home Minister Amit Shah, to settle disputes concerning 123 villages.
• In 1951, a sub-committee headed by Assam's first Chief Minister Gopinath Bordoloi recommended changes that led to the transfer of around 3,648 sq km of land to Assam.
• Assam and Arunachal Pradesh share an approximately 804-km-long boundary, and according to CM Himanta Biswa Sarma, only 52 disputed areas across five sectors currently remain unresolved.

title: India, US in 'regular contact' on trade deal, says commerce secretary Agrawal
content:
• Indian exports to the US increased by nearly 13% to $9.02 billion in July, while imports from the US grew by 18.1% to $5.5 billion in the same month.
• The US has levied an additional 10% tariff on goods from India and several other countries since July 24, linked to the US Section 301 forced-labour measure.
• India's Commerce Secretary, Rajesh Agrawal, stated that India and the US are committed to finalizing their trade deal framework despite ongoing US Section 301 investigations into India’s trade practices.

title: E20 petrol controversy | India's top carmakers privately raise serious concerns about fuel contamination: Report
content:
• E20 petrol, which is blended with 20% ethanol content, has been mandatory nationwide in India since 1 April this year.
• Fuel testing revealed high chloride contamination in E20 petrol, with levels reaching up to 570 parts per million (ppm) in Rajasthan, significantly exceeding India's permissible limit of 3 ppm.
• Moisture levels in E20 petrol also breached permissible limits, with Andhra Pradesh recording up to 13,000 ppm against the government's benchmark of 3,000 ppm.

title: India, US remain in regular contact on proposed trade deal: Commerce Secretary
content:
• The US last month levied an additional 10% duty on Indian goods under a Section 301 probe concerning alleged forced labour.
• The 10% duty is lower than the 12.5% tariff the US proposed in June as part of a broader Section 301 probe under its Trade Act.
• A US Bill allows President Donald Trump to impose 100% tariffs on goods from countries identified as the top five importers of Russian oil and gas.

title: India in 'regular contact' with US on trade deal, says Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal
content:
• India and the US are targeting bilateral trade of $500 billion by 2030, up from the current $191 billion.
• The US has levied an additional 10 per cent tariff on goods from India and several other countries since July 24.
• The contours of the first phase of the Bilateral Trade Agreement (BTA) were finalised in February, the same month it was formally proposed.

title: Parliamentary panel backs govt steps to strengthen IBC recovery, seeks deeper action on fund diversion
content:
• Only about Rs 7,500 crore has been recovered from 1,326 applications involving avoidance transactions valued at Rs 3.76 lakh crore, highlighting a significant recovery gap under the IBC.
• The IBBI issued a circular on November 4, 2025, providing a mechanism for restitution of assets attached under the PMLA, using a standardised undertaking developed jointly by the IBBI and the ED.
• The average time taken for resolution under the IBC has risen to 853 days in 2024-25 against the mandated 330-day timeline, with 30,600 IBC cases pending before 30 NCLT benches.

title: RBI turns upbeat as worst of Iran war shock recedes
content:
• Inflation in India remained within the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)'s 2%-6% tolerance band.
• India imports almost 90% of its crude oil, making it vulnerable to global oil price surges.
• Historically, the RBI has rarely opted for policy rate hikes during the October–December festive period to avoid dampening consumer demand.

title: Papad Khar to attract 18% GST, says Gujarat AAR
content:
• Papad Khar, a key ingredient for papad, will attract an 18 per cent GST rate, as ruled by the Gujarat AAR.
• Papad, irrespective of its shape, size, or form, remains exempt from GST.
• The Gujarat AAR clarified that GST jurisprudence does not establish a principle that raw materials should be exempt from GST simply because the finished product is exempt.

title: India in 'regular contact' with US on trade deal: Comm Secy
content:
• Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal confirmed India is in "regular contact" with the US for negotiating a proposed bilateral trade agreement (BTA), committed to a framework deal agreed upon in February.
• The US has imposed an additional 10% tariff on Indian goods, effective from July 24, under a Section 301 probe on alleged forced labour concerns.
• The US Senate approved a bill that allows the US President to impose 100% tariffs on goods from countries, including India, identified as top five importers of Russian oil and gas.
